title: Merging
definition: Merging combines two already sorted arrays into one larger sorted array.
realLifeExample: It is like merging two sorted attendance lists into one final sorted list.

algorithm.Iterative:
1. Compare the current front elements of both lists.
2. Move the smaller one to the output.
3. Repeat until one list ends.
4. Append the remaining elements.
5. Return the merged result.
algorithm.Functions:
1. Put the merge logic inside one helper function.
2. Continue comparing and copying elements.
3. Return the completed merged array.
algorithm.Recursion:
1. Compare the current front elements.
2. Copy the smaller one.
3. Recurse on the remaining part.
4. Stop when one list is exhausted.
